subject: DI01000191

intro_text.en: Bilingual teaching notes with construction, working, applications and revision. Exam has questions only. Use supervised models; no actual practical is claimed.
intro_text.gu: English technical keywords સાથે સરળ ગુજરાતી સમજ. Construction, working, applications અને revision. Exam માં માત્ર પ્રશ્નો. Supervised model વાપરો; actual practical નો દાવો નથી.

body.en:
Material handling moves, positions, stores or controls materials through a workplace process. Goals include reduced manual strain, suitable throughput, less damage, safe access and efficient use of space. Movement that adds no product value should still be planned safely and minimised where appropriate.

Examples are moving stock to a machine, lifting an assembly, conveying cartons and placing loads in storage. The right device depends on material, route and risk—not just lifting power.
body.gu:
Material handling workplace માં material move/position/store/control કરે. Manual strain ઘટાડવું, throughput, damage reduction, safe access અને space use મુખ્ય હેતુ. અનાવશ્યક movement ઓછું કરો, પણ જરૂરી movement safe plan કરો.

Machine પાસે stock, assembly lifting, cartons conveying અને storage examples. Material/route/risk પ્રમાણે device પસંદ થાય, માત્ર lifting power નહીં.

body.en:
Hoisting raises/lowers suspended loads; conveying moves material along a designed path; surface equipment travels/supports loads at floor level; overhead equipment uses elevated travel/support structures.

Categories overlap: an overhead crane both hoists and travels. Classify by the task being discussed rather than forcing every device into exactly one exclusive group.
body.gu:
Hoisting suspended load ઉપર/નીચે કરે; Conveying designed path પર material; Surface equipment floor પર travel/support; Overhead elevated travel/support.

Overhead crane hoist અને travel બંને કરે; categories overlap છે. Task પ્રમાણે classify કરો, એક જ exclusive group ફરજિયાત નહીં.

body.en:
Assess load mass, shape, centre of gravity, fragility, temperature and hazard; travel distance/direction, lift height, throughput, available aisles/structure and people interaction. Use rated capacity at the actual configuration, not an arbitrary maximum brochure number.

Include gripping/support method, maintenance, operator training, traffic control and emergency arrangements. A faster device can increase congestion/risk if the whole process is not coordinated.
body.gu:
Load mass/shape/centre of gravity, fragility/T/hazard; route/distance/height/throughput અને aisles/structure તપાસો. Actual configuration ની rated capacity લો, brochure નો મોટો number નહીં.

Support/grip, maintenance, training, traffic/emergency planning ઉમેરો. Whole process વગર speed વધારવાથી risk/congestion વધી શકે.

body.en:
A hoist uses a designed chain/rope/drum or mechanical arrangement to raise/lower a load through a rated hook/support. Manual chain blocks use gearing/mechanical advantage and a designed load-control mechanism; powered hoists add a motor and controls.

Mechanical advantage trades force for movement; it does not create energy. Rated hoists and brakes must be used with approved support/rigging. Never use a homemade friction brake or ordinary rope as a substitute for rated lifting equipment.
body.gu:
Hoist designed chain/rope/drum વડે rated hook/support થી load ઉપર/નીચે કરે. Manual chain block gearing/mechanical advantage અને load-control mechanism; powered માં motor/controls.

Mechanical advantage force/movement trade-off છે, energy બનાવતું નથી. Rated support/rigging જોઈએ; homemade brake/ordinary rope substitute નહીં.

body.en:
A crane combines hoisting with controlled movement across a working area. Jib cranes sweep a designed arc; gantry cranes use supported legs/structure; bridge/overhead cranes move on elevated runways. Exact motions and capacities depend on the design.

A crane chart/configuration and lifting plan govern actual limits. Side-pulling, swinging loads and moving people under a suspended load create hazards. Operators and riggers require appropriate training/authorisation.
body.gu:
Crane hoisting સાથે area માં controlled travel આપે. Jib arc, gantry legs/structure, bridge/overhead elevated runway વાપરે. Motions/capacity design પ્રમાણે.

Actual limits crane configuration/chart અને lifting plan પર. Side-pull/swing અને load નીચે લોકો unsafe. Trained authorised operator/rigger જરૂરી.

body.en:
A continuous belt runs over supporting idlers/bed and end pulleys, driven by a suitable motor/transmission. It carries compatible bulk or unit loads along the designed route. Loading, discharge, belt tracking, take-up and guarding are important functions.

Applications include cartons, packaged products and suitable granular material. It is not suitable for every hot, sharp, oily or hazardous load without appropriate design. Never step onto a conveyor or clear a jam while energised.
body.gu:
Continuous belt idlers/bed અને pulleys પર drive થાય; suitable bulk/unit load route પર લઈ જાય. Loading/discharge/tracking/take-up/guarding મહત્વનાં.

Cartons/packages/granular material માટે suitable design. દરેક hot/sharp/oily/hazardous load માટે નહીં. Conveyor પર ચઢવું અથવા energised jam clear નહીં.

body.en:
Roller conveyors support suitable flat-bottom unit loads on rollers, using gravity or powered rollers as designed. Screw conveyors move appropriate bulk material by a rotating screw in a trough/tube. Bucket elevators carry suitable bulk material upward in attached buckets.

Choice depends on particle behaviour, contamination, incline, flow and guarding. Screw/pinch points can severely injure; use isolated models and approved jam-clearing procedures.
body.gu:
Roller conveyor flat-bottom load rollers પર gravity/power થી; Screw conveyor trough/tube માં rotating screw થી suitable bulk; Bucket elevator attached buckets વડે bulk ઉપર.

Particle behaviour/contamination/incline/flow/guarding પરથી selection. Screw/pinch points serious injury; isolated model અને approved jam-clearing જ.

h.en: 11.4.1 Trolleys, hand trucks and pallet trucks
h.gu: 11.4.1 Trolleys, Hand Trucks અને Pallet Trucks

body.en:
Surface handling devices support loads on wheels/forks for floor-level movement. Trolleys/hand trucks suit appropriate manually moved loads; pallet trucks lift a compatible pallet slightly for travel rather than serving as arbitrary high-lift platforms.

Stability depends on load position, wheel/floor condition, slope and operator force. Use compatible load ratings and secure/clear routes. Never carry people or use a pallet truck as a work platform unless specifically designed/certified for that purpose.
body.gu:
Surface devices wheels/forks પર floor movement આપે. Trolley/hand truck suitable manual load; pallet truck compatible pallet થોડું ઉઠાવી travel કરે, arbitrary high-lift platform નહીં.

Stability load position/wheels/floor/slope/force પર. Rated loads અને clear routes. People carrying/work platform તરીકે નહીં, જો ખાસ designed/certified ન હોય.

body.en:
A forklift lifts/transports compatible loads on forks or rated attachments. Mast, carriage, forks, tyres, power/drive, hydraulic/control and stability systems work together. Capacity changes with load centre, height and attachment configuration.

Suitable applications include pallet storage and loading under a traffic/lifting plan. A nominal truck capacity does not apply to every long/offset load. Never stand under raised forks or improvise passenger platforms; trained authorised operators follow the exact manual.
body.gu:
Forklift forks/rated attachment થી load lift/transport કરે. Mast/carriage/forks/tyres/power/hydraulic/control/stability systems જોડાય. Capacity load centre/height/attachment સાથે બદલાય.

Pallet storage/loading માટે traffic plan જરૂરી. Nominal capacity દરેક offset/long load માટે same નથી. Raised forks નીચે ઊભા નહીં; passenger platform improvise નહીં.

body.en:
An overhead bridge crane typically combines runway travel, bridge movement, trolley positioning and a hoist. A monorail carries a trolley/hoist along a single designed elevated track. They can preserve floor space but impose loads on certified supporting structures.

Applications include assembly/maintenance bays and designed plant routes. Inspection and travel/limit controls matter. An overhead beam that looks strong is not proof of rated lifting support.
body.gu:
Bridge crane runway/bridge/trolley/hoist motions આપે; monorail single elevated track પર trolley/hoist. Floor space બચી શકે પણ supporting structure પર loads જાય.

Assembly/maintenance bays/plant routes માં. Inspection/limit controls જરૂરી. Beam મજબૂત દેખાય એટલે certified lifting support નહીં.

body.en:
For repeated cartons on a fixed route, consider a suitable belt/roller conveyor. For a heavy assembly raised in a maintenance bay, consider a properly rated hoist/crane and engineered lifting plan. For pallet movement/storage, consider a compatible pallet truck/forklift with route and stability planning.

These are selection concepts, not an approval to lift a real load. Compare whole-system cost, access, damage risk and training—not only device name or speed.
body.gu:
Repeated cartons fixed route માટે suitable belt/roller conveyor. Maintenance bay માં heavy assembly માટે rated hoist/crane અને lifting plan. Pallet move/storage માટે compatible pallet truck/forklift, route/stability plan.

આ selection concepts છે, real lift approval નહીં. Whole-system cost/access/damage/training સરખાવો.

body.en:
Keep people outside suspended-load zones and guarded nip areas. Verify rated equipment, compatible attachments, inspections, stable support and authorised operation. Isolate electrical/mechanical/gravity/stored energy before maintenance. Never improvise load tests.

Record actual observations on safe models/charts. Revision: match need → material/route → equipment principle → application → safety limits. No lifting, capacity certification or physical test was performed in these notes.
body.gu:
Suspended-load zones અને guarded nip areas થી લોકો દૂર. Rated equipment/attachments/inspection/stable support/authorised operator જરૂરી. Maintenance પહેલાં electrical/mechanical/gravity/stored energy isolate. Improvised load test નહીં.

Safe model/chart માં જોયેલું જ record કરો. Revision: need → material/route → principle → application → limits. અહીં actual lifting/test/certification નથી.

a.en: No, a crane can hoist and travel.
Compatible bulk/unit loads on fixed route.
Rotating screw advances suitable bulk material.
a.gu: Rotating screw bulk material આગળ કરે.

items.f: Need -> load -> route -> rated equipment -> safe operation

terms.en: Do not select from nominal capacity alone.

Practice: Explain surface equipment and applications.

Practice: State inspection and stored-energy safety.
